title: Build a simple Observable in TypeScript — 3 turns
description: Three turns build an Observable: turn 1 subscribe/next, turn 2 error/complete, turn 3 pipe/map operator.

task_spec.prompt: Implement `subscribe(observer: Observer<T>)` in `src/observable.ts`. Wrap the observer so missing callbacks default to no-ops. Call `this._subscriberFn` with the wrapped observer. Track whether unsubscribed, and if so don't call next/error/complete. Return a Subscription object with an unsubscribe function. Run `npm test -- --forceExit`.
followup_prompts: Good. Now implement `from<T>(values: T[]): Observable<T>` — create an Observable that calls observer.next for each value synchronously. Also implement the `error` and `complete` behavior in subscribe: after complete() is called, subsequent next() calls should be ignored. Run `npm test -- --forceExit` and fix any failures.

Final step: implement `map<T, U>(fn)` operator and `pipe(operator)`. map returns a function that creates a new Observable subscribing to the source and calling fn on each next value. pipe applies the operator to this observable. Run `npm test -- --forceExit` — all 6 tests must pass.
success_criteria: subscribe delivers next values to observer
